title: Moving from Microsoft Access VPro 64 to VPro 2.0
summary: How familiar VPro 64 tools—the Data Centre, Access project files, species lists, Site Units, and diagnostic workbooks—carry over into VPro 2.0 projects.

sections.heading: No Microsoft Access Needed
sections.body: VPro 2.0 opens legacy Microsoft Access .mdb and .accdb project files directly without installing Microsoft Access or switching between 32-bit and 64-bit Access drivers. Working projects are stored in self-contained VPro project files (.db) that support safe simultaneous reading.

sections.heading: From Floating Data Centre to Projects & Context
sections.body: The left Projects & context panel replaces the old floating Data Centre window, keeping your active Project, Site Unit, Hierarchy, Lump, and Theme tables visible at all times and protected against accidental overwrites.

sections.heading: Importing BECMaster and Field Projects Safely
sections.body: Open Project Admin or the Interchange Hub to import .accdb and .mdb archives. Any malformed entries or unmatched vegetation and soil rows with no matching plot header are placed in an import quarantine log with a full audit receipt instead of being silently dropped.

title: FS882, Two-Page, SIVI & Multi-Plot Datasheet Entry
summary: Fast keyboard plot entry, live LMH25 (2023) field checks, NotInList species matching, and multi-plot spreadsheet editing.

sections.heading: FS882, Two-Page & SIVI Forms
sections.body: Press Enter to move smoothly across plot header fields and down vegetation and soil grids. Turn on "Show extended shrub layers" only when recording northern or subalpine shrub sub-layers (Cover5a to 5c), SnowCoverRegime, or ActiveLayerDepth.

sections.heading: F1 LMH25 (2023) Field Help
sections.body: Focus any Site, Soil, Vegetation, or SIVI field and press F1 to open the offline LMH25 (2023) reference, picklist codes, humus depth measurement rules, and interactive rSMR and rSNR keys.

sections.heading: Multi-Plot 9-Table Datasheet
sections.body: Review and edit Site Environment, Vegetation, Humus, Mineral Soil, Other, Admin, Audit, Site Unit, and Hierarchy tables in a fast multi-plot spreadsheet with tab-separated clipboard paste, Find and Replace, and automatic audit history.

title: Site Unit Explorer, Taxon Lumping & Live BEC Diagnostics
summary: Dual-pane Site Unit and Hierarchy management, Lumping Presets & Rules, and live BEC differential species synthesis.

sections.heading: Dual-Pane Site Unit & Hierarchy Explorer
sections.body: Drag or reassign plots across Site Units, organize 12-level classifications with tilde (~) report breakpoints, synchronize assignments between Site Units and plot records, and filter .support, .poor, or .nudum units from summary tables.

sections.heading: Live BEC Differential & Pairwise Synthesis
sections.body: Replaces legacy Excel diagnostic macros: calculates Presence Class (I–V), Goldstream Mean Cover, Differential Value (d, d1–d3, dd1–dd4, cd), and Cramér or Sørensen pairwise similarity. Results update immediately as plots move between units and export to a formatted 4-sheet VPro diagnostic Excel workbook (.xlsx).

title: 3D Map Spatial QA, climr aSMR & Quarto Guides
summary: Offline 3D Map with BGC v13 boundary checks, lasso selection into Site Units, climr climate normals, candidate plot clustering, and Quarto BEC guides.

sections.heading: Offline 3D Map & Spatial Checks
sections.body: View provincial BGC v13, Ecosections, and Natural Resource Districts on an offline 3D Map, flag swapped coordinates or BGC boundary mismatches in the field, and select plots directly into Site Units with a lasso tool.

sections.heading: R Companion Tools (climr, Clustering & Quarto)
sections.body: When R is installed locally, VPro stores downscaled climate normals in the plot climate cache, maps climate moisture deficit to aSMR alongside rSMR by rSNR edatopic grids, saves non-destructive candidate Site Unit tables, and renders BC Gov styled Quarto HTML or PDF Site Unit and BGC guides.

title: 2026 BC BEC Standards & Open Data Exchange
summary: Built-in BECdb v13 (2026) and BCPlantTaxonomy v19 (2026) reference lists plus clean exchange with VENUS 5.0 XML, TurboVeg 3, GeoPackage, CSV, and R .rds.

sections.heading: Pinned 2026 Provincial Standards
sections.body: Every VPro 2.0 release includes verified built-in standards for BECdb v13 (2026-05-28) and BCPlantTaxonomy v19 (2026-02-09) alongside LMH25 (2023) rules, viewable anytime under Help, About VPro & Standards Libraries.

sections.heading: Open Ecosystem Interchange
sections.body: Import and export VENUS 5.0 XML, TurboVeg 3 archives, OGC GeoPackage (.gpkg in BC Albers EPSG:3005 or WGS84 EPSG:4326), Long and Wide CSV matrices, and native R (.rds) project snapshots.

title: Cloud BECMaster Sync & Ministry Certificate Setup
summary: Provincial Cloud BECMaster staging and custodian merges over encrypted connections, with support for custom enterprise root certificates on Windows and macOS.

sections.heading: Enterprise Root Certificates (SSL_CERT_FILE & SSL_CERT_DIR)
sections.body: Remote Cloud BECMaster connections always require encrypted TLS. Alongside the system certificate store on Windows, macOS, and Linux, VPro checks SSL_CERT_FILE (certificate file path) and SSL_CERT_DIR (certificate folder) so BC Gov enterprise or custom root certificates can be trusted without changing system keychains.

sections.heading: Pre-Upload Checks & Custodian Merge
sections.body: Submitted plots pass pre-upload compliance checks before entering staging, and custodian reviews run as a conflict-checked custodian merge with tamper-evident audit history.
